svg.title: Manta Bot responsibility division: Raspberry Pi and Arduino Mega
svg.desc: Pi owns stamped ROS commands, differential-drive kinematics, C++ serial translation, assumed wheel states, direct LiDAR SLAM and Flask on port 5000. Camera source-only scripts are disabled. Mega owns command parsing, the nonlatched watchdog and ESTOP, nominal 50 Hz local PI regulation, encoders and PWM outputs. Wheel RPM commands cross to Mega over UART; signed telemetry at 5 Hz returns but is unused by the plugin. ROS odometry is command-derived. Neither separate drive nor SLAM launch is complete.
svg.text: Manta Bot | Responsibility division
Pi owns high-level ROS and direct sensors. Mega closes the local wheel-speed loop and drives motor outputs.
Raspberry Pi
Arduino Mega
Commands and differential-drive kinematics
GamepadCmdVel: Movement/controller.py; manual start
Flask UI_app.py: HTTP 5000 to TwistStamped /cmd_vel
diff_drive_controller in ros2_control; manager configured at 50 Hz
Wheel velocity targets in rad/s; stamped-command timeout 0.5 s
C++ manta_hardware/MantaHardware
write(): rad/s to RPM and serial wheel command packet
read(): mirrors commands into velocities and integrates positions
/diff_drive_controller/odom and wheel TF are command-derived
NOT measured feedback; read_status() is unused.
Direct LiDAR, mapping and web UI
rplidar_ros/rplidar_composition on /dev/ttyUSB0
/scan to async SLAM Toolbox; outputs /map and map to odom
robot_state_publisher: URDF and command-derived /joint_states
Flask has no sensor subscriptions; dashboard placeholders
Camera source only | setup.py entries commented out
camera_publisher.py: OpenCV capture to /image_raw
yolo26_ros2.py: /detections + /image_annotated/compressed
stream.py: compressed images to browser over HTTP 9091
Separate stream server; camera bypasses Mega
main.cpp | command parser and software stops
V:leftRPM,rightRPM sets both local wheel targets
Command silence >500 ms: closed_loop_stop()
VS and ESTOP stop outputs; ESTOP is not latched
A later valid drive command can resume motion
closed_loop.cpp + pid.cpp | local PI regulation
Nominal 50 Hz; 20 ms threshold and actual elapsed dt
Proportional + integral only; encoder deltas to signed RPM
Measured speed magnitudes compared to target magnitudes
Cooperative loop, not hard real-time or a braking guarantee
encoder.cpp | local quadrature feedback
Motor 1 A/B: D18/D19; motor 2 A/B: D20/D21
CHANGE interrupts on channel A pins D18 and D20
748 counts per wheel revolution = 11 × 2 × 34
Measurements close the Mega loop, not a ROS encoder topic
motor_control.cpp | physical outputs and telemetry
PWM D2/D7; direction D3-D6
Two H-bridge channels to two motors; board count unspecified
Signed RPM1/RPM2 telemetry emitted at 5 Hz
SS direct Serial.println is commented out
Pi to Mega | configured commands
/dev/ttyAMA0 at 115200 baud
V:leftRPM,rightRPM + newline
VS on plugin activation / deactivation
Mega to Pi | unused telemetry
Signed RPM1/RPM2, emitted at 5 Hz
Plugin read() does not consume it
Missing measured feedback path
ROS odometry assumes commanded wheel motion
Sensors connect directly to Pi.
No LiDAR or camera data through Mega.
System integration and safety boundary
Compose diff_drive.launch.py and slam.launch.py separately; neither is a complete robot launch. Gamepad is installed but not automatically launched.
Camera console scripts are disabled. Configured flow does not assert runtime availability or measured physical motion.
Watchdog / ESTOP set PWM = 0 and direction pins LOW; software stops are nonlatched and do not establish hard real-time behavior or guaranteed braking.
Legend | distinct configured, disabled and unused states
Solid blue: configured commands / data
Long dashed purple: disabled camera
Short dashed amber: unused telemetry
